issues.description: play.ts scratch debugging file with console.logs and local relative import committed in the diff
issues.detail: play.ts imports from a developer-local path and contains exploratory console.log calls. This is scratch work that should not ship in a PR. Remove it or convert any intended assertion into a real test.

issues.description: JSON.stringify used as structural equality in flattenRef dedup logic
issues.detail: Two loops compare JSON.stringify(schema[key]) === JSON.stringify(refSeen.def![key]) to decide property deletion. Key ordering, undefined fields, and nested object identity silently change behavior, and it is asymptotically expensive in a hot path. Use a real structural-equality helper or reference compare.

issues.description: overrideCount test doubled from 6 to 12 with no documented rationale
issues.detail: Removing the `if (!seen.isParent)` guard makes overrides fire for parent/wrapper schemas, doubling invocations. This is a user-visible behavior change for anyone using custom overrides. Either state the new invariant in a code comment and commit message, or add a dedicated test pinning the intended semantics.

issues.description: flattenRef complects four concerns with no stated invariant or termination argument
issues.detail: finalize/flattenRef now handles processor-ref inheritance, parent-chain refinement subtraction, $ref-extraction dedup, and parent-$ref propagation behind shared mutation of `schema`. No postcondition is documented and termination rests on a single `seen.ref = null` sentinel with no proof. Split the concerns or add a literate-programming invariant block.

issues.description: Seen.ref field overloaded with multiple meanings; (zodSchema as any)._zod.parent cast defeats the new typed parent field
issues.detail: `ref?: $ZodType | null` simultaneously means unset, null-sentinel for already-flattened, and inherit-from. Meanwhile the code immediately reaches through `(zodSchema as any)._zod.parent` instead of trusting the typed `seen.parent` it just introduced. Split into explicit fields (e.g. inheritFrom + flattened) and remove the any-cast.

issues.description: fileProcessor anyOf output shape change bundled into a metadata-propagation PR
issues.detail: Each anyOf branch previously carried contentEncoding/format/maxLength/minLength/type; those are now hoisted to the root with anyOf entries holding only contentMediaType. This is a user-visible JSON Schema change buried in an unrelated refactor. Split into its own patch with rationale for downstream validator compatibility.

synthesis.summary: The panel agrees the fix correctly identifies the root cause — conflating processor `ref` with clone-chain `parent` — and splitting them in `Seen` is the right data-structure move. However the implementation ships with several taste failures: a scratch play.ts file with console.logs, JSON.stringify used as structural equality in a hot dedup path, an unexplained doubling of override invocations (6→12), and flattenRef braiding four concerns without a stated invariant. Additional concerns include an `(any)` cast that defeats the freshly-typed parent field and a fileProcessor output-shape change bundled into an otherwise-unrelated PR. Consensus: directionally correct, NEEDS-WORK before landing — strip scratch, replace stringify equality, justify the override-count change, and split the file-processor patch.
